newsitem.title: USA: Navidec sets one mln unit IPO at $6 per unit.
newsitem.headline: Navidec sets one mln unit IPO at $6 per unit.

text.p: Navidec Inc said Tuesday its initial public offering of one million units will be priced at $6 per unit.

Each unit will consist of one warrant and one common share, the company said. Of the one million shares, the company is selling 755,000 shares and 245,000 are being sold by the Bridge Financing Selling Stockholders of Navidec, the company said.
The stock and warrants will trade on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market under the symbols "NVDC" and "NVDCW" respectively.
The offering is being led by Joseph Charles & Associates.
